title: Set up Orval in an Nx workspace
description: Register the nx-orval plugin in nx.json and add Orval to the workspace. Every project with an orval.config.* file gets a cached, inferred Orval target. Safe to rerun, and what `nx add nx-orval` runs.

examples.description: Register the plugin and add orval to devDependencies
Name the inferred target codegen instead of orval
Only register the plugin, leave package.json untouched

targetName.description: Name of the inferred Orval target. Ignored when nx.json already registers nx-orval; that entry is never changed.

skipPackageJson.description: Do not add orval to package.json.

keepExistingVersions.description: Keep the version of orval the workspace already declares instead of raising it to the version nx-orval is tested with.
